annotations.title: What each type of sales role posts in pay

description: The pay employers post for each kind of sales work today: the median and the middle half (25th to 75th percentile) of the posted figures, with how many figures and companies stand behind each one. A kind appears only once three or more companies post pay for it. Use it when the user asks what a kind of sales role pays (for example what an SDR or an enterprise account executive makes). It lists no roles: to find roles that pay at least a figure, use search_sales_jobs with min_pay_usd.
